moment: “The first time, it startled you into looking away. Then it kept the proof. Every time you obey the flinch, it adds another line.” The oldest copy speaks your name. The door answers by carving it beneath **FILED**. Behind you, the stone arch that led back to the shop closes without a sound. The test failed. The file still found its subject.
style: Engraved etching illustration, dense crosshatching, fine ink linework, monochrome, no colour. Heavy blacks, high contrast, deep shadow, dark inked plate. The characters are anthropomorphic cats.
